name: kill_session_command
description:
Sends a signal to terminate a running command in a session. The signal can be used to gracefully stop (SIGTERM) or forcefully kill (SIGKILL) the process. The command must still be running for this operation to succeed.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd/{cmdId}/kill --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cmdId.description: The unique identifier of the command to terminate.

signal.description: The POSIX signal number to send to the process. Common values: 15 (SIGTERM) for graceful termination, 9 (SIGKILL) for forced termination.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the session containing the command.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
